description: Banuelos and Carroll proved deep connections between the expected lifetime of Brownian motion in a simply connected domain and its inradius. The maximal expected lifetime over domains with inradius 1 is dual to the Bloch-Landau constant problem.
mathematical_formalization: E_z[tau_D] <= C * R_D^2; torsion function u: Delta u = -2, u|_{partial D}=0; int_D u = (1/2)E_0[tau_D]; lambda_1(D) >= pi^2/(4R_D^2).
analogical_connections: Brownian exit time ~ diffusion in porous media
Inradius constraint ~ bandwidth constraint in signal processing
Expected lifetime maximization ~ optimal stopping in finance
implementation_hypothesis: Monte Carlo Brownian motion simulation in candidate extremal domains. Estimate E_z[tau_D] and use probabilistic perspective to suggest new domain shapes.
experiment_seed: Simulate 10^6 Brownian paths in strip, 3-slit, and 4-slit domains (inradius 1). Compare empirical exit times.
